title: Sign-up and sign-in
what: Email and password with the consent box on sign-up; returning people go straight to Home. Google and Apple are next.

title: Welcome and onboarding
what: A four-panel welcome, who you are looking after, life-stage journeys (pregnancy, new parent, ageing parent) and a first upload.

title: Family, plans and switching
what: Up to four members by plan, faces for every age or a real photo, health basics per member, and every screen follows the member in view.

title: Pregnancy and birth
what: Track a pregnancy by period or scan dating; at birth the baby becomes a member and carries what the pregnancy knew.

title: Consent, privacy and data rights
what: Versioned policies, a consent ledger, a re-consent gate, privacy requests, a storage notice and cache controls.

title: Delete my account
what: Removes records, files, photos and the sign-in itself; the consent and rights records are kept as the law asks.

title: App lock
what: Face ID or fingerprint before the app opens, with a grace period; a lock on a door, not a safe.

title: Scan and upload
what: Camera, photos or a PDF, whose report it is, and a type picker; files go to private storage with EXIF stripped. The reader behind it is still a stand-in.

title: Health records
what: Eleven record types, each with its own detail page, filters by member, type and time, a timeline, and move, retype or delete.

title: Health file
what: One page per member: basics, values over time, what is worth a look, who they have seen, recent records, and a share.

title: Family health memory
what: Readings, trends, the medicine ledger, open loops, the life-stage clock and corrections, built on the phone for each member.

title: Safety router
what: Eleven emergencies and five urgent patterns in English, Hindi and Hinglish go straight to a 112 or 108 card, before any model is asked.

title: Ask Cheeku chat
what: One continuous thread per member with urgency tiers, starters from their records, a switch when the question is about someone else, and booking cards in the thread. Answers come from a stand-in until the model is ready.

title: Chat relay and metering
what: The cheeku-chat function forwards to the model, keeps the urgency floor, meters every call, and gives free families 20 chats a day.

title: Home stages
what: Starter, building and Today, unlocked by the first record, with a week streak, what is due soon and family alerts.

title: Today's action plan
what: A daily plan across five pillars built from each person's readings, conditions, medicines and life stage: steps with proof, meal photos read against their numbers, readings, sleep and breathing.

title: Calmer Today
what: Three tasks for right now, the rest folded under Later today, a progress ring, and Done folds the card away with a haptic.

title: Goal cards
what: Five goals with two questions each; the plan carries the goal's check-ins, a streak and an optional daily reminder.

title: Notifications
what: An inbox with live updates, categories and read state, settings per kind, and phone reminders for appointments, lab visits, records and goals. The server push sender is written but not switched on.

title: Worth knowing (Learn)
what: Plain-language articles with categories, saved items and reading history, picked for the member in view.

title: Lab tests at home
what: Catalogue, packages, cart, choose a lab, slots, a booking tracker and results back into records. Runs on sample labs until LabStack is connected.

title: Doctor consults
what: Doctor directory, profiles with ratings and reviews, slots, a chat-led consult with a pre-consult note, and appointments. Sample doctors and a placeholder video room for now.

title: Book services
what: One hub for dental, eye, physio, home care, transport and medicines, with requests and a waitlist; a preview provider answers for now.

title: Plans and paywall
what: Free, Solo and Family, a paywall built around one decision, and plan management. Upgrades are a demo until store billing.

title: UI audit batches 1 to 3
what: Haptics, one bottom sheet with drag to dismiss, one press feel, skeletons, one type, radius and colour scale, one primary button, and a lint guard. Checked on a phone.

title: Cheeku the mascot
what: The chikoo character in brand colours with eleven moments, moves and peeks, plus the illustration set and faces for every age.

title: Content system
what: Who Cheeku is, five writing rules, slot limits, notification formulas and health meaning words, held by copy tests.

title: Mobile web app
what: The same app on the web at cheeku-ai-mobile.vercel.app, with a shell that feels installed on a phone.

title: Row-level security
what: Every table locks rows to their family; documents sit in private storage, 10 MB, images and PDFs only.

title: Database and migrations
what: 37 migrations, each with step files, a check query and local Postgres scenarios.

title: Edge Functions
what: cheeku-chat, push-dispatch and delete-account on Supabase.

title: Automated tests
what: 434 unit tests across safety, memory, the plan, goals, records, billing and copy; CI is next.

title: Trackers and team docs
what: This launch tracker, the LabStack partnership tracker, PLAN and PROGRESS, the PR template and the UI audit.

title: Pitch decks, thesis and videos
what: Investor decks with the proven-markets slide, a two-page thesis for cold outreach, a launch video and a product demo video.
